def normalize_name(text: str) -> str:
    """Normalize free-text place labels for alias and keep-out matching.

    Case folding and punctuation stripping let operators type informal names
    while the resolver compares stable tokens.
    """
    t = text.casefold()
    t = _PUNCT_RE.sub(" ", t)
    t = " ".join(t.split())
    if t.startswith("the "):
        t = t[4:]
    return t.strip()

def load_site(path: Path) -> Site:
    with path.open("rb") as f:
        raw = tomllib.load(f)
    site_raw = raw.get("site", {})
    keep_outs_raw = raw.get("keep_out", [])
    places_raw = raw.get("places", [])

    def coord(c: list[float]) -> Coord:
        return (float(c[0]), float(c[1]))

    site = Site(
        id=str(site_raw["id"]),
        name=str(site_raw["name"]),
        home=coord(site_raw["home"]),
        geofence=tuple(coord(p) for p in site_raw["geofence"]),
        geofence_margin_m=float(site_raw.get("geofence_margin_m", 0)),
        keep_out=tuple(
            KeepOut(
                name=str(k["name"]),
                polygon=tuple(coord(p) for p in k["polygon"]),
                margin_m=float(k.get("margin_m", 0)),
            )
            for k in keep_outs_raw
        ),
        places=tuple(
            Place(
                name=str(p["name"]),
                aliases=tuple(str(a) for a in p.get("aliases", [])),
                kind=p["kind"],
                points=tuple(coord(pt) for pt in p["points"]),
            )
            for p in places_raw
        ),
    )
    _validate_site(site)
    return site

def validate(plan: MissionPlan, ctx: ValidationContext) -> ValidationReport:
    issues = validate_structure(plan, ctx)
    if issues:
        issues_sorted = tuple(sorted(issues, key=issue_sort_key))
        return ValidationReport(
            ok=False,
            issues=issues_sorted,
            resolved=None,
            plan_hash=plan_hash(plan, ctx),
            validator_version=VALIDATOR_VERSION,
        )

    resolved = build_resolved(plan, ctx)
    end_state = final_state_after_plan(plan, ctx)
    issues.extend(check_spatial_and_energy(resolved, ctx, end_state))
    issues_sorted = tuple(sorted(issues, key=issue_sort_key))
    ok = not any(i.severity == "error" for i in issues_sorted)
    return ValidationReport(
        ok=ok,
        issues=issues_sorted,
        resolved=resolved if ok else None,
        plan_hash=plan_hash(plan, ctx),
        validator_version=VALIDATOR_VERSION,
    )

def _issue(
    code: IssueCode,
    action_index: int | None,
    params: dict[str, Any],
    message: str = "",
    hint: str = "",
) -> ValidationIssue:
    from robot_copilot.validator.explain import explain_issue

    msg, h = explain_issue(code, action_index, params) if not message else (message, hint)
    return ValidationIssue(
        code=code,
        severity="error",
        action_index=action_index,
        params=tuple(sorted(params.items())),
        message=msg,
        hint=h,
    )

def rth_legs(
    pos: XYZ,
    state: str,
    veh: DroneProfile | RoverProfile,
    home: tuple[float, float],
) -> list[tuple[str, XYZ, XYZ, float, float, float]]:
    """Returns list of (kind, start, end, speed, distance, duration)."""
    if state in ("ground_home", "at_home"):
        return []
    legs: list[tuple[str, XYZ, XYZ, float, float, float]] = []
    x, y, alt = pos.x_m, pos.y_m, pos.alt_m
    hx, hy = home
    if isinstance(veh, DroneProfile):
        rth_alt = max(alt, veh.rth_altitude_m)
        if state == "ground_away" or alt < rth_alt:
            target = XYZ(x_m=x, y_m=y, alt_m=rth_alt)
            dz = abs(rth_alt - alt)
            dur = dz / veh.vertical_speed_mps if dz > 0 else 0.0
            legs.append(("climb", pos, target, veh.vertical_speed_mps, dz, dur))
            pos = target
            alt = rth_alt
        dist = math.hypot(hx - x, hy - y)
        end = XYZ(x_m=hx, y_m=hy, alt_m=alt)
        dur = dist / veh.cruise_speed_mps if dist > 0 else 0.0
        legs.append(("move", pos, end, veh.cruise_speed_mps, dist, dur))
        pos = end
        if alt > 0:
            target = XYZ(x_m=hx, y_m=hy, alt_m=0.0)
            dz = alt
            dur = dz / veh.vertical_speed_mps
            legs.append(("descend", pos, target, veh.vertical_speed_mps, dz, dur))
    else:
        dist = math.hypot(hx - x, hy - y)
        end = XYZ(x_m=hx, y_m=hy, alt_m=0.0)
        dur = dist / veh.cruise_speed_mps if dist > 0 else 0.0
        legs.append(("move", pos, end, veh.cruise_speed_mps, dist, dur))
    return legs

def _confirm(self, mission_id: str, phash: str) -> RunView:
        m = self._store.get_mission(mission_id)
        if m is None:
            raise KeyError(mission_id)
        if m.status != "valid":
            self._store.audit(mission_id, "confirm_rejected", {"reason": "not_confirmable"})
            raise ConflictError(ConflictCode.NOT_CONFIRMABLE, "Mission cannot be confirmed.")
        if m.plan_hash != phash:
            self._store.audit(mission_id, "confirm_rejected", {"reason": "hash"})
            raise ConflictError(ConflictCode.PLAN_HASH_MISMATCH, "Plan hash does not match.")
        if m.validated_at is None:
            raise ConflictError(ConflictCode.NOT_CONFIRMABLE, "Mission cannot be confirmed.")
        validated = datetime.fromisoformat(m.validated_at)
        if self._clock() - validated > timedelta(seconds=self._settings.confirm_ttl_s):
            self._store.audit(mission_id, "confirm_rejected", {"reason": "expired"})
            raise ConflictError(ConflictCode.CONFIRMATION_EXPIRED, "Confirmation window expired.")

        rev = self._store.get_latest_revision(mission_id)
        if rev is None or not rev.plan_json:
            raise ConflictError(ConflictCode.REVALIDATION_FAILED, "Stored plan missing.")
        plan = MissionPlan.model_validate_json(rev.plan_json)
        ctx = self._ctx(m.vehicle, m.battery_pct)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        report = validate(plan, ctx)
        if not report.ok or report.plan_hash != phash:
            self._store.audit(mission_id, "confirm_rejected", {"reason": "revalidation"})
            raise ConflictError(ConflictCode.REVALIDATION_FAILED, "Plan no longer validates.")

        sim = simulate(report, ctx)
        run = Run(
            id=self._store._id(),
            mission_id=mission_id,
            plan_hash=phash,
            status=sim.status,
            frames_json=json.dumps([f.model_dump(mode="json") for f in sim.frames]),
            photos_json=json.dumps([p.model_dump(mode="json") for p in sim.photos]),
            final_state_json=json.dumps(sim.final_state.model_dump(mode="json")),
            created_at=self._clock().isoformat(),
        )
        ttl_cutoff = self._clock() - timedelta(seconds=self._settings.confirm_ttl_s)
        run_id = run.id
        ok = self._store.commit_confirmation(
            mission_id,
            m.revision,
            phash,
            ttl_cutoff,
            run,
            [("confirmed", {}), (sim.status, {})],
        )
        if not ok:
            raise ConflictError(ConflictCode.NOT_CONFIRMABLE, "Mission cannot be confirmed.")
        return RunView(
            id=run_id,
            mission_id=mission_id,
            status=sim.status,
            frames=list(sim.frames),
            photos=list(sim.photos),
            final_state=sim.final_state,
        )

def commit_confirmation(
        self,
        mission_id: str,
        rev: int,
        plan_hash: str,
        validated_not_before: datetime,
        run: Run,
        events: list[tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]],
    ) -> bool:
        with Session(self._engine) as session:
            m = session.get(Mission, mission_id)
            if m is None or m.status != "valid" or m.revision != rev or m.plan_hash != plan_hash:
                return False
            if m.validated_at is None:
                return False
            val_at = _require_aware(datetime.fromisoformat(m.validated_at))
            if val_at < _require_aware(validated_not_before):
                return False
            m.status = "executed" if run.status == "executed" else "aborted"
            session.add(m)
            session.add(run)
            for kind, detail in events:
                self._audit(session, mission_id, kind, detail)
            try:
                session.commit()
            except Exception:
                session.rollback()
                return False
            return True

def commit_repair_failure(
        self,
        mission_id: str,
        rev: int,
        attempts: int,
        generation: int,
        status: str,
        detail: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> bool:
        with Session(self._engine) as session:
            m = session.get(Mission, mission_id)
            conv = session.get(Conversation, m.conversation_id if m else "")
            if (
                m is None
                or conv is None
                or conv.generation != generation
                or m.status != "repairing"
                or m.revision != rev
                or m.repair_attempts != attempts
            ):
                return False
            m.status = status
            session.add(m)
            self._audit(session, mission_id, "provider_error", detail)
            session.commit()
            return True

async def _read_post_body(receive: Receive, max_bytes: int) -> tuple[bytes | None, Receive]:
    """Read the full POST body (chunked or not). Returns (None, receive) when over max_bytes."""
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    total = 0
    while True:
        message = await receive()
        if message["type"] != "http.request":
            return None, receive
        chunk = message.get("body", b"")
        total += len(chunk)
        if total > max_bytes:
            return None, receive
        chunks.append(chunk)
        if not message.get("more_body"):
            break

    body = b"".join(chunks)
    sent = False

    async def replay_receive() -> Message:
        nonlocal sent
        if not sent:
            sent = True
            return {"type": "http.request", "body": body, "more_body": False}
        return await receive()

    return body, replay_receive

def __init__(
        self,
        model: str,
        api_key: SecretStr,
        *,
        timeout_s: float,
        max_retries: int,
        max_output_tokens: int,
        client: Any | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.model = model
        self._max_output_tokens = max_output_tokens
        self._max_args = 32768
        if client is not None:
            self._client = client
        else:
            from google import genai

            self._client = genai.Client(
                api_key=api_key.get_secret_value(),
                http_options=genai.types.HttpOptions(
                    timeout=int(timeout_s * 1000),
                    retry_options=genai.types.HttpRetryOptions(attempts=1 + max_retries),
                ),
            )
